# External code

Everything under `external/` is third-party code that this project carries but did not write. It keeps its own license and copyright notices.

`PS2Recomp/` is a modified copy of [PS2Recomp](https://github.com/ran-j/PS2Recomp) by ran-j and contributors (GPL-3.0). `PS2Recomp/DW5XL_VENDORED.md` records the upstream revision it is based on and what was changed; [THIRD_PARTY.md](../THIRD_PARTY.md) lists all third-party sources and notices.

The port's own code lives in `app/`, `recomp/` and `tools/`.
